subject: Vulnerability scan aggregation + SIG mapping & CVE remediation playbook
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <security@quantumpay.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@qualys-scan.net
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VM evidence request: consolidated mapping to SIG controls + per-CVE timeline

Dylan,

Thanks for agreeing to pull together a consolidated package for our SOC2 intake. We have two audit threads running in parallel: a SIG questionnaire and a CAIQ spot-check. Instead of separate uploads, can you provide: 

- A single vulnerability-scan aggregation PDF that shows the last three authenticated scan runs mapped to workload owners and affected assets;
- A per-CVE remediation log (CSV) with dates, current status, ticket ids, and whether a mitigation or full patch was applied;
- A short mapping (spreadsheet) that calls out where each SIG/CAIQ control is satisfied by the VM cadence and evidence (e.g., CC-VM-4 => weekly authenticated scans + agent telemetry).

Important callouts the reviewers will ask about:
- Scan cadence and scope (authenticated scanner vs agent-based);
- SLA adherence for CRITICAL/HIGH/ MEDIUM CVEs historically;
- Proof that critical/active exploit CVEs were triaged within 24 hours and remediated or mitigated per our SLA;

Please include owner names for each asset and links to the remediation tickets. We want to avoid back-and-forth, so the spreadsheet should be indexable (searchable column headers etc.).

Can you get a first-pass package by EOD Friday (6/30)? If you need a sample format, I attached our intake template from the last audit.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Security Lead | QuantumPay

---

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <security@quantumpay.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request: consolidated mapping to SIG controls + per-CVE timeline

Alex —

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alex Mercer <security@quantumpay.com> wrote:
> Dylan,
>
> Thanks for agreeing to pull together a consolidated package for our SOC2 intake...

Got it. We’ll assemble a single package that covers:

1) Aggregated scan report (last 3 weeks) — authenticated network/host scans + agent telemetry reconciliation.
2) Per-CVE remediation log (CSV) with ticket links to RG- (internal routing) and JIRA where applicable.
3) SIG/CAIQ compact mapping (spreadsheet) that references specific artifacts (screenshots of scan run, user-acknowledged patch PRs).

Quick operational notes so expectations are aligned: 
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans across prod and pre-prod; daily agent-based telemetry (endpoint sensors) with automated delta alerts.
- SLA: Critical (P0) => 7 days to patch or apply mitigation with escalation; High (P1) => 30 days; Medium => 90 days. We have historically completed P0 fixes in a median of 5 days (data attached).
- Evidence indexing: each CSV row will include: cve_id, severity, asset_fqdn, owner, ticket_id, first_seen, triage_date, mitigation_date, closure_date, evidence_link.

I’ll own the aggregation and SIG/CAIQ mapping. Soojin will export the agent telemetry reconciliation and the raw scan artifacts; Marissa will pull historical SLA metrics and the median time-to-remediation summaries; Jordan will validate the ticket links and attach screenshots of patch PRs where available.

Deliverables and owners:
- redwood-vm-aggregate-report-2027-06-30.pdf — Dylan (aggregation + executive summary)
- cve-remediation-log-2027-07-01.csv — Soojin (raw rows exported from the RMDB)
- sig-caiq-mapping-compact-2027-07-01.xlsx — Marissa (mapping + references)

We’ll include a short narrative in the PDF that explains our automated controls: prefix caching for runtime (relevant to SIG: CC-RUNTIME-3), continuous batching effects on attack surface, and our fallback model routing which has separate infra isolation (relevant for scoping).

If QuantumPay needs a statement signed by our compliance lead, flag that and I’ll loop in Markus from Security Ops.

We’ll send the package to you once Soojin uploads the scans and Marissa confirms metrics — aiming for EOD tomorrow (7/1).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Product Security (VM lead) | Redwood Inference

---

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Alex Mercer <security@quantumpay.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request: consolidated mapping to SIG controls + per-CVE timeline

Dylan / team —

Attached the exports and a short playbook snippet. Attached files:
- redwood-vm-aggregate-report-2027-06-30.pdf (contains run dates: 2027-06-09, 2027-06-16, 2027-06-23; scope: prod, pre-prod, mgmt-plane)
- cve-remediation-log-2027-07-01.csv (columns as discussed; includes links to internal ticket tracker and public advisories where relevant)
- sig-caiq-mapping-compact-2027-07-01.xlsx (column "control_ref" maps to artifacts in the PDF)

Playbook highlights (snippet):
- Initial triage within 24 hours for any CVE flagged as Active Exploit or with Proof-of-Concept.
- Temporary mitigation prioritized if kernel/infra-level patching will take >72 hours; mitigation documented in ticket and evidence link added to CSV.
- Escalation path: SRE on-call -> Infra lead (Jordan Blake) -> Security Ops (Markus Klein) within the SLA horizon.

SLA historical snapshot appended to the PDF: median P0 = 5 days (n=12 in last 12 months), median P1 = 21 days, P2 = 64 days. We also included a table with three examples of critical CVEs (CVE-2025-0412, CVE-2026-1987, CVE-2027-1122) showing triage->mitigation->closure with ticket ids.

Notes on scope and limitations to surface to auditors:
- Third-party managed services (some cloud infra components) have a separate patch window; we include their advisories and ticket references but remediation ownership is noted in the mapping sheet.
- Certain low-priority findings in pre-prod are excluded from the PDF summary but present in the CSV for completeness.

I uploaded the artifacts to the Drive folder and added links in the CSV. If you want, I can also generate a condensed one-page attestation statement for SOC2 that calls out the cadence and SLA table explicitly.

Attached: redwood-vm-aggregate-report-2027-06-30.pdf; cve-remediation-log-2027-07-01.csv; sig-caiq-mapping-compact-2027-07-01.xlsx

—
Soojin Lee
Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management | Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Mercer <security@quantumpay.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request: consolidated mapping to SIG controls + per-CVE timeline

Dylan / team —

Received the package and reviewed the CSV + mapping spreadsheet. This is exactly what we needed for the SIG intake. A couple of small follow-ups: 

- Can you add a one-line attestation in the PDF that the CSV rows are exhaustive for the prod scope as of 2027-06-30?
- For the three P0 examples, please add the exact mitigation PR links (we saw ticket ids but the auditors like the PRs / deployment anchors).

If you send those two items by EOD Monday, we can close out the SOC2 evidence request and move the CAIQ spot-check to completed. Thanks for the quick turnaround — the mediation/mitigation notes were clear and the SLA snapshots helped a lot.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Security Lead | QuantumPay
